single.rationale: T1 Energy faces severe structural challenges: massive operating losses ($235M in FY2025 despite $755M revenue), aggressive share dilution (24% YoY), substantial regulatory uncertainty around OBBBA compliance affecting critical tax credits, and execution risk on a $400M+ capex project (G2_Austin) while burning cash. The 260x revenue jump masks a distressed asset acquisition with negative 31% operating margins, concentrated geographic/supplier risk, and leased facilities that constrain operational flexibility.

team.thesis: T1 Energy operates one of the few U.S. facilities producing both solar cells and modules domestically, positioning it to capture domestic content tax credits driving utility-scale demand, but the company remains deeply unprofitable with operating losses widening from $79.0M to $234.6M despite revenue surging from $2.9M to $755.3M, while execution risks on the capital-intensive $400-425M G2_Austin
